            is_negative = True
            amount_str = amount_str[1:-1].strip()
            
        # Remove currency symbols and thousands separators

            if is_negative:

            totals[cat] = totals.get(cat, 0) + amount
        except ValueError:

    return {cat: round(total, 2) for cat, total in totals.items()}

        except ValueError:

    # Round totals to 2 decimals
    return {cat: round(total, 2) for cat, total in totals.items()}
